blocks.text: For more than 100 years, our politicians perfected one trick: turning the money of ordinary taxpayers into a private slush fund for themselves, their families and their friends. It has had different names at different times: Public Works Funds, Countrywide Development Fund, PDAF, Disbursement Acceleration Program, “unprogrammed appropriations,” “Ayuda.” The name changes. The stealing doesn’t. […]... Keep on reading: Even his own blood isn't above the law
